task.text:
WRITING TASK 2
You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.
Some people say history is one of the most important school subjects. Other people think that, in today’s world, subjects like science and technology are more important than history. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your knowledge or experience.
Write at least 250 words.

paragraphs: Opinions are varied whether History or other subjects such as science and technology are the most essential subjects at school nowadays. Personally, I strongly believed that all academic fields are equally necessary.

Admittedly, history serves as a basis knowledges for students, especially the young children. Initially, the students are exposed to a wide range of knowledge in history, they may be able to know how their countries was founded, the wars the ancient people started in order to protect their nations, the cultures and traditions, which help the youngsters to love and respect the people who defended their country. These students, moreover, become responsible and careful of their actions based on the ancient citizens' mistakes and become a good individual in the future.

On other hand, Science and technology subjects are also a dispensable sectors in students' life. These academic sectors not only equipped students with the valuable knowledge but also develop the nation economy. For example, the founder of Facebook had spent years researching on what people interest in the most in his university, coding a small app for people to socialise and posting status, which resulting in Facebook with huge technological companies across the world nowadays. Furthermore, subjects like Science and technology are both needed in school since they showed students how things work around them, making them more practical, mature and responsible in the real-life world.
In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that history are as the subjects such as science and technology. Therefore, it would be a unwise decision to overlook one of those subjects.
review.overall: Cô thấy em đã bàn cả lịch sử lẫn khoa học và nói rõ rằng cả hai đều cần ở trường. Em có ví dụ về công nghệ, nhưng cần giải thích nó chứng minh ích lợi của việc học khoa học như thế nào. Trước tiên, hãy sửa chữ “dispensable”, vì từ đó mang nghĩa có thể bỏ đi, trái với lập luận của em. Sau đó tách các câu quá dài và kiểm tra chủ ngữ–động từ.

criteria.label: Task Response
criteria.comment: Em trả lời cả hai phía và giữ lập trường các môn đều cần; ví dụ Facebook dài nhưng liên hệ với việc dạy môn học chưa đủ rõ.

criteria.label: Coherence and Cohesion
criteria.comment: Bốn đoạn có vai trò rõ, song nhiều câu thân bài quá dài, ghép ý và mệnh đề không trọn nên mạch giải thích đứt.

criteria.label: Lexical Resource
criteria.comment: Có từ vựng theo chủ đề, nhưng “basis knowledges”, “dispensable” và nhiều dạng từ làm nghĩa lệch.

criteria.label: Grammatical Range and Accuracy
criteria.comment: Em thử câu phức, mệnh đề quan hệ và not only...but also; lỗi hòa hợp, thì và cấu trúc mệnh đề lặp lại.

annotations.explanation: Hai mệnh đề độc lập không thể nối chỉ bằng dấu phẩy; dùng “When... , they...”.

annotations.title: Từ làm ngược ý
annotations.explanation: “Dispensable” nghĩa là có thể bỏ; em đang muốn nói các môn này cần thiết. “Sectors” cũng phải hợp với mạo từ số nhiều.

annotations.title: Song song động từ và ý
annotations.errorTypeLabel: Song song động từ và ý
annotations.explanation: Chọn cùng thì/dạng ở hai vế; “develop the nation economy” nên nói “support the national economy”.

annotations.quote: what people interest in the most
annotations.title: Thiếu động từ nối
annotations.explanation: “Interested” là tính từ, cần “are” và giới từ “in”.

annotations.quote: which resulting in Facebook with huge technological companies across the world nowadays
annotations.title: Mệnh đề quan hệ hỏng
annotations.explanation: Sau “which” cần động từ chia thì, còn kết quả của dự án phải được nói rõ.

annotations.quote: they showed students how things work
annotations.title: Thì thời gian
annotations.explanation: Em đang nói giá trị hiện tại của môn học nên dùng “show”.
annotations.replacement: they show students how things work

annotations.quote: history are as the subjects such as science and technology
annotations.title: So sánh chưa hoàn chỉnh
annotations.explanation: Muốn nói quan trọng ngang nhau, dùng cấu trúc “as important as”; “history” số ít đi với “is”.
annotations.replacement: history is as important as subjects such as science and technology

annotations.title: Mạo từ trước nguyên âm
annotations.explanation: “Unwise” bắt đầu bằng âm nguyên âm, nên dùng “an”.

paragraphs.text: Whether schools should give more attention to history or to science and technology remains debated. I believe all three areas are important because they teach students different ways to understand the world and prepare for adulthood.

History provides young people with knowledge of how their communities developed. When students examine the founding of a country or the causes of a past conflict, they learn that decisions have consequences for real people. They can also consider how different groups experienced the same event. This helps them value cultural traditions while thinking carefully about mistakes made in the past. Such lessons may encourage responsibility and empathy, which are useful when students later take part in civic life.

Science and technology are equally necessary. Science teaches students to test explanations against evidence, while technology gives them opportunities to apply that knowledge to practical problems. For example, a pupil who learns coding can design a simple online tool that helps classmates share information. Building it requires logical thinking, testing and revision. These habits matter even if the student does not become a programmer, because digital systems shape work and communication in many fields. Understanding how evidence and digital tools work also helps students judge claims they encounter online instead of simply repeating them. A well-taught science curriculum can therefore support both individual opportunities and the wider economy.

In conclusion, history helps students interpret human experience, whereas science and technology help them investigate and improve their surroundings. Since these benefits complement one another, it would be unwise to remove any of these subjects from school.
